# sherpa-provider

The data layer, over a SUBTREE of the page.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-provider/sherpa-provider.example.json) |

## When to use it

Put it round the part of a page whose components need data: each component inside asks, and the provider answers from the sources `provide()` gives it, or that `open()` opens from a page definition. It draws nothing.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-provider><p>What it provides for.</p></sherpa-provider>
```

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `provide(options: ProvideOptions)` | Give this subtree its sources — and its Views. Every component already asking is answered again: a Context that swaps its source swaps it for everything in it. Settles once the kept Query, or the start View, is on. |
| `open(definition: PageDefinition, options: OpenOptions)` | Set up a page from its DEFINITION: its source over the app's store, every filter bar drawn from its scope — the View chip, the fields it holds, what it may add — and all of it provided. The source, or undefined for a page with no data. |
| `prepare(definition: PageDefinition \| null)` | A page is about to be drawn from this definition, or from none: take its filter mode NOW — the panel open or shut — so its content is never drawn twice. `open()` follows. |
| `recheck()` | Try every source that cannot reach its store again — a page's Retry. |
| `close(options: { next?: boolean } = {})` | Leave the page, or one still opening: its source goes, and nothing in the subtree reaches it. `next`: another page follows at once, and says whether the panel stays. |
| `saveView(label?: string, options: { stay?: boolean } = {})` | Save what is on screen as a View of the open page, and put it on the View chip. With a name, a NEW View — a name any View has already gets ` - Copy-001`. With none, over the reader's own View on screen; a preset is never overwritten, so that answers undefined. The saved View's id, else undefined. `stay`: keep it for later, and stay on the View on screen — the save before a Reset all to default. |
| `deleteView(id?: string)` | Delete the reader's own View — the one on screen unless named — and go to the first. A preset is never deleted. |
| `saveFilters(label?: string)` | SAVE FILTERS — every scope's filters under a name, kept with the page beside its Views. A set of the same name is saved over, so a host asks first. With none, over the set last taken ("Save &lt;name>"); none taken answers undefined. The set's id. Will, TODO 105, 366. |
| `applyFilters(id: string)` | TAKE a saved set: every scope matches it; one it does not name has no filters. |
| `dismissFilters(id: string)` | TAKE a saved set OFF: the scopes it names lose their filters. |
| `deleteFilters(id?: string)` | DELETE a saved set — the one last taken unless named. Its filters stay on screen. |
| `resetView()` | Put the filters back as the View on screen DEFINES them: the page's first Query, then the View's, as a pick puts it on. A filter the reader added since goes. What "Reset all to default" does. |
| `export()` | This subtree's whole state as JSON — each source's question, and the View on screen — for a link, another service or an agent. |
| `import(state: ProviderState)` | Take a state back in, exactly: each named source's question, and its View — shown on the View chip, and known to the pick listener, so the next pick of the old View is heard. A source it does not name is left as it is. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `filter-mode-change` | `{ mode: 'panel' \| 'toolbars' }` | The filters moved between the toolbars and the panel. |
| `view-change` | `{ elements: Record<string, HTMLElement> \| undefined; id: string \| undefined }` | A View was picked, opened or saved. |
| `reach-change` | `{ failure: Failure; reach: 'down' \| 'ok' \| 'unreached' }` | Whether the page's data can be reached changed. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | content | the subtree — every component in it can ask |

`{ keepContent? }`
